message: 29F, about 8 weeks pregnant. I started bleeding this morning, more than spotting, with cramping in my lower belly.

findings.quote: I started bleeding this morning, more than spotting

findings.finding: Prior vaginal bleeding in this pregnancy

question.text: Have you passed any tissue, clots, or material from the bleeding?
question.why: Passage of products of conception would suggest miscarriage rather than threatened miscarriage and affects management urgency and counseling.

basis.quote: I started bleeding this morning, more than spotting, with cramping in my lower belly
basis.interpretation: Active vaginal bleeding beyond spotting with concurrent lower abdominal cramping at approximately 8 weeks gestation, concerning for threatened miscarriage, ectopic pregnancy rupture, molar pregnancy, or other pregnancy-related emergency
Pregnancy at a gestation where both intrauterine and ectopic pregnancies remain viable and rupture risk is present; bleeding at this stage carries risk of life-threatening hemorrhage if ectopic

output.reason: Vaginal bleeding with cramping in early pregnancy requires immediate emergency evaluation to exclude ectopic rupture, miscarriage complications and other time-critical obstetric emergencies.

notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

output.reason: Bleeding heavier than spotting with lower abdominal cramping at about 8 weeks pregnant requires hands-on assessment today with ultrasound, blood tests and exam, which messaging cannot provide, because ectopic pregnancy must be excluded.
output.patientMessage: Please be seen in person today — an urgent obstetric/gynecology or emergency service — for an ultrasound, blood tests and exam, because bleeding heavier than spotting with cramping at 8 weeks needs the cause identified, including ruling out an ectopic pregnancy. Go to the emergency department immediately if bleeding soaks through pads hourly, you pass tissue, or you feel faint, dizzy, or have shoulder pain.
differential: Threatened or in-progress early pregnancy loss
